description: Rank every electricity plan in a Texas utility by ESTIMATED ANNUAL COST on the given usage (not just the 1,000 kWh price). Bill-credit plans are modeled with their credit cliff month by month. Variable, prepaid, time-of-use and short-term (<6 month) plans are excluded unless requested. Each item has a url to cite. Free for non-commercial use with attribution; commercial use requires Pro.

charging_efficiency.description: Default 0.90 with ev_kwh_per_mile; 1.0 with vehicle (EPA figures include charging losses)

ev_miles.description: Optional EV: miles driven per month; adds home-charging kWh to every month (fixed-rate plans).

kwh.description: Average monthly usage in kWh (default 1000). Spread over a typical Texas year (summer-heavy).

months.description: Optional: 12 monthly kWh values, January first. Overrides kwh.

term.description: Contract length in months; short = under 6 months

utility.description: Utility (TDU) id. Dallas–Fort Worth: oncor · Houston: centerpoint · Corpus Christi / Rio Grande Valley: aep_central · Abilene / San Angelo: aep_north · Texas City / Lewisville: tnmp · Lubbock: lpl

vehicle.description: Optional EV model id for its EPA efficiency (see electricity_ev_charging_cost), e.g. tesla-model-y-long-range-awd

name: electricity_rank_plans
